item.text:
Extended coverage with a real membership transition:

- Snapshoted a three-voter cluster.
- Committed removal of one voter.
- Committed another write.
- Restarted the two survivors.

Both survivors incorrectly reconstructed the removed voter from the older snapshot, confirming serious stale-membership consequences.

Updated artifacts:

- [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_09-39-48-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/report.md)
- [audit_repro_test.go](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-17_09-39-48-hashicorp_raft-baseline/work/audit_repro_test.go)

Latest full suite `985a4fac967f421a98e4236ef0715cb3`: all pre-existing tests pass, with eleven audit failures. Randomized existing-test runs remain clean. The audit remains at six findings.
